title: Senior Paid Social Specialist
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Paid Social Specialist to lead performance-driven campaigns across platforms like Meta, TikTok, Pinterest, and CTV. This role goes beyond execution, combining creative strategy, campaign management, and data analysis to drive results at scale.

You’ll own the full lifecycle of paid social campaigns, from building and optimizing to scaling accounts often exceeding $1M/month, while working closely with creative, brand, and analytics teams. We’re looking for someone deeply experienced in Meta direct response advertising, with a strong track record of selling products through paid social and a sharp understanding of short-form video creative.

This is a fast-paced, high-accountability environment where you’ll collaborate directly with leadership to grow high-performing U.S. brands. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious marketers operating at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

What you'll do:

- Plan, develop, and implement comprehensive paid media strategies primarily focused on Paid Social to increase brand visibility and recognition and drive new user acquisition and leads via paid media campaigns.

- Conduct thorough brand and website audits to understand our clients’ key value propositions, core products, and brand aesthetics and identify opportunities to successfully market them and make them stand out in the marketplace.

- Obsession with short form creative and direct response creative to convert customers - how to best sell a product, how to best construct a hook, how to best guide a client on how their advertising dollars should be spent behind winning creatives.

- Conduct competitive research to ensure success in the ad space and new acquisition audience targeting.

- Manage between 5-10 Paid Media accounts (including but not limited to: Meta Ads, TikTok Pinterest, and other social platforms like Twitter and TikTok) on behalf of Darkroom clients, with aggregate monthly spends ranging between $80,000 - $3M.

- Utilize Platform Ad Managers, third-party reporting tools, andAI to develop insights and action items intended to increase our clients’ revenues month-over-month and solve for attribution.

- Religious mastery of important KPIs like CPA, CAC, iROAS, nCAC, MER, aMER, CTR, TSR, and Hold Rate.

- Understand industry-wide benchmarks throughout all steps in the e-commerce marketing funnel.

- Implement real-time, proactive, and reactionary ad-buying decisions across multiple platforms in response to up-or-down trends happening on ads platfo

title: Sales Development Representative - New York
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.

About the role

As a Sales Development Representative at Cursor, you'll be the tip of the spear for pipeline generation, the first voice a prospective customer hears, and the person who earns their attention before an Account Executive ever gets on a call. You'll work across the full range of our commercial segments, from fast-moving startups to mid-market engineering organizations, identifying the right buyers and creating the conditions for meaningful sales conversations.

This isn't a role for someone who waits for leads to come in. You'll build pipeline from scratch, learn how great engineering teams think, and develop a deep understanding of how Cursor transforms developer productivity. It's the fastest way to learn enterprise sales at one of the most exciting companies in AI.

What you'll do

- Generate qualified pipeline for our Account Executive team through high-volume outbound prospecting, including cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn, and creative multi-channel sequences

- Research target accounts and map stakeholders across Engineering, Product, and Leadership to identify the right entry points

- Conduct discovery conversations that go beyond surface-level qualification, understand how development teams work, what's slowing them down, and where Cursor fits

- Partner closely with AEs to develop account strategies, hand off opportunities cleanly, and stay looped in as deals progress

- Hit and exceed weekly activity targets and monthly qualified meeting goals

- Represent Cursor's brand and product with conviction; you'll be many prospects' first impression of the company

- Bring market intelligence back to the team: what resonates, what objections are coming up, what messaging is landing

- Help build the playbook. As an early SDR, your patterns and learnings will shape how this function scales

 

You may be a fit if

- You have 1-2 years of experience in a sales, customer-facing, or business development role. SDR/BDR experience at a SaaS or developer tools company is a strong plus

- You're a relentless self-starter who takes ownership of your pipeline and doesn't wait to be handed leads

- You write and speak with clarity. You can explain a complex product simply and tailor your message to a technical audience

- You're curious about how software gets built and excited by the idea that AI is fundamentally changing the craft

- You're organized and data-driven: you track your activity, learn from your numbers, and iterate quickly

- You have thick skin and genuine resilience. You don't take rejection personally and you bounce back fast

- You want to grow into an Account Executive role and are willing to put in the reps to get there

title: Software Engineer, Intern
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

 

As an engineering intern, you'd play a critical role in lots of our projects. We're pretty flexible on what projects people work on based on their skills and interests.

Who You Are

- Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field AND are willing to take off a semester to work full time in SF. Remote and part-time interns are not accepted.

- You have experience with some high performance language (C++, Rust, etc.)

- You often code technically difficult or interesting projects for fun

- You care about the problem of finding high quality information and recognize how important this is for the world

What You Could Do

- Recreate Google-level keyword search over 10 billion pages in 1 month

- Build a state-of-the-art crawling system that works optimally for any website

- Build a custom vector database that runs over a billion vectors in under 100ms

This is an in-person opportunity in San Francisco. We're happy to sponsor international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3).

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Director, Operations Reporting & Analytics
description:
ABOUT MATTER HEALTH
Matter Health delivers primary and preventive healthcare directly to older adults living in affordable housing communities. Our mission is simple: to improve healthcare access by meeting patients where they are and building trusted relationships within the communities we serve. As we rapidly expand across the country, we are building a team of mission-driven professionals who thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments.
TOTAL HEALTHCARE. WHERE YOU LIVE.
ABOUT THE ROLE
Matter Health is seeking an experienced Director, Operations Reporting & Analytics to lead the reporting and analytics function that gives market, clinical, and executive teams a clear and consistent view of organizational performance.
In this role, you will own operational and clinical reporting from end to end, including KPI definition, dashboard design, data quality, reporting governance, and self-service analytics. You will partner closely with Operations, Clinical, Finance, Quality, Implementation, Data Engineering, and IT teams to translate business needs into timely, reliable, and actionable reporting solutions.
You will also play a critical role in new-market launches by ensuring each market has the dashboards, data feeds, KPI definitions, and reporting infrastructure needed to operate effectively from day one. This is a hands-on leadership position responsible for managing and developing the current analytics team while building scalable reporting capabilities as Matter Health continues to grow.
This position is ideal for a strategic and execution-focused analytics leader who can turn complex data into clear insights, establish trusted reporting standards, and help leaders at every level make informed decisions.
RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own the strategy, standards, tooling, and governance for operational and clinical reporting across all Matter Health markets

• Design, build, and maintain dashboards and scorecards that measure market, provider, Care Support, clinical, and enterprise performance

• Establish and maintain a single source of truth for enterprise KPI definitions, calculation methodologies, metric logic, and naming conventions

• Partner with Data Engineering and IT to define data-pipeline requirements, improve data quality, and develop scalable reporting and analytics solutions

• Translate operational, clinical, financial, and executive business questions into clear reporting requirements and actionable insights

• Own reporting readiness for new-market launches, including dashboards, data feeds, KPI definitions, and reporting infrastructure

• Build self-service reporting capabilities and train market and functional leaders to use data and reporting tools effectively

• Manage the analytics roadmap and prioritize recurring reporting needs alongside ad hoc analysis requests from executive leadership

• Partner with Finance, Clinical Operations, Quality, and Implementation to support budgeting, forecasting, risk stratification, care-model decisions, and organizational planning

• Establish reporting quality-control processes and resolve inconsistencies in data, metric calculations, and dashboard outputs

• Drive continuous improvement in reporting turnaround times, data accuracy, dashboard adoption, and the end-user experience

• Gather feedback from reporting users and incorporate that feedback into dashboard design, reporting priorities, and process improvements

• Ensure reporting and analytics practices comply with HIPAA, data-privacy standards, and applicable healthcare requirements

• Manage, coach, and develop analysts and reporting specialists while helping scale the team as the organization grows

• Model Matter Health ’s values of Empathy, Trust, Tenacity, Teamwork, and Curiosity

QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, business, statistics, health informatics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

• Eight or more years of progressive experience in reporting, business intelli

title: SAP Consolidations Manager, International Accounting
description:
GAQ327R292

We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve - leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. We are looking for two Consolidations Managers to join our Global Accounting team based in India. These are foundational hires - you will own the end-to-end consolidation and intercompany accounting process across Databricks' 23-entity global footprint, build deep SAP Group Reporting expertise during our S/4HANA implementation, and establish the permanent organisational capability that scales with the business post go-live.

This role blends hands-on consolidation execution with technical accounting judgment. As part of the Global Accounting organisation, you will ensure the accurate and timely production of consolidated financial statements under both US GAAP and IFRS, while partnering closely with International Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Tax, and FP&A to drive close integrity across all reporting frameworks.

The impact you will have:

• Own and execute the global consolidation process end-to-end - intercompany reconciliation, elimination entries, currency translation, and multi-entity roll-up across our 23-entity footprint.

• Lead multi-GAAP close execution, producing parallel US GAAP and IFRS consolidated books each period, identifying and documenting reconciling differences for audit and leadership review.

• Build and own SAP Group Reporting expertise - serve as the accounting team's subject matter expert on SAP's consolidation engine, including configuration, period-end processing, and ongoing optimisation.

• Execute intercompany accounting across all entities - ensuring balances are reconciled, disputes are resolved within the close window, and elimination entries are complete and accurate.

• Perform monthly consolidation flux analysis, identifying and clearly articulating drivers behind significant period-over-period movements for leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Own FX translation and revaluation accounting - functional currency determination, translation adjustments, and CTA reconciliation across all international entities.

• Support new entity stand-up - partner with Tax, Legal, and International Accounting to establish consolidation processes, intercompany agreements, and reporting structures for new international selling entities as Databricks expands.

• Serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external audit on consolidation, intercompany, and multi-GAAP reporting matters. Champion compliance with SOX controls across the consolidation process.

• Drive AI and automation adoption across consolidation workflows - including automated intercompany matching, elimination entry generation, and reconciliation tooling leveraging the Databricks platform.

• Partner with the Senior Manager, Close & Consolidation (US) to ensure seamless handoff and time-zone coverage for the most time-sensitive part of the global close.

What we look for:

• BA/BS Degree with a focus in Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, or Finance.

• 10+ years progressive accounting experience, with at least 5+ years specifically in consolidation, intercompany accounting, or international accounting within a US multinational framework.

• A Chartered Accountant (CA) or CPA equivalent certification is mandatory. 

• Deep understanding of US GAAP consolidation requirements (ASC 810, ASC 830) and working knowledge of IFRS consolidation standards (IFRS 10, IAS 21). Multi-GAAP reporting experience is strongly preferred.

• SAP S/4HANA experience required - specifically SAP Group Reporting or SAP BPC. Candidates with implementation experience will be prioritized.

• Proven experience managing intercompany accounting at scale - reconciliation, netting, dispute resolution, and elimination across a multi-entity, multi-currency environment.

TL;DR

Lovable is looking for a Solutions Marketing Lead to own go-to-market strategy across new markets, audiences, and use cases, starting with our SMB market. This person will be building the positioning, experiments, and cross-functional playbooks that turn early signals into repeatable growth engines. This role has a direct line to how Lovable wins with everyone from solo founders to enterprise teams, at one of the fastest-growing companies in Europe.

 

WHY LOVABLE?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

 

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

As Solutions Marketing Lead, you'll own the strategy for how we show up and win across a wide range of markets, audiences, and use cases, many of which we're still in the process of defining. The first priority market segment to focus on will be SMB. Over time you'll move between buyer segments fluidly, building the playbooks and messaging that turn early traction into repeatable motion from the ground up.

You will spend your time across the full arc of go-to-market work: spotting the opportunity, developing the hypothesis, designing the experiment, and synthesizing what you learn into a recommendation leadership acts on. We're looking for someone who comes in with a strong point of view, earns trust quickly, and drives outcomes across the organization without needing a large team behind them.

You’ll thrive in this role if you have:

- 12+ years of marketing experience with a deep understanding of the SMB audience

- Owned a solutions marketing playbook from zero to one at a B2B SaaS or developer-focused company, not just executed against one someone else built.

- Directly owned a large, cross-functional initiative where you were the person accountable for the outcome, not just coordinating the calendar.

- Built positioning and messaging for more than one buyer segment at the same time and can point to how each differed and why.

- Designed a GTM experiment, read the signal, and turned it into a recommendation that leadership acted on.

- Marketed across multiple audiences at once while keeping a coherent brand narrative, not five disconnected campaigns that don't feel like the same company.

- Positioned developer tools, no-code/low-code platforms, or AI products, and understand the nuances of speaking to both technical and non-technical audiences.

 

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Own the GTM strategy for new and evolving market opportunities: identify where we have potential to win, build the hypotheses, and design the experiments to validate them.

- Go from 0 to 1 across multiple use cases, personas, and buyer segments simultaneously, developing positioning, messaging, and campaign infrastructure from scratch.

- Lead major cross-functional initiatives spanning marketing, product, GTM, content, and community, driving alignment and shipping with urgency.

Join a team of curious problem solvers that celebrates differences, leads with empathy and values inclusivity.
As a Senior Customer Engineer, you own the technical customer relationship end to end. You run discovery independently, design integration and agentic workflow architectures for complex enterprise problems, and deploy solutions live with customers - often before they know exactly how to articulate what they need. You write optimized, production-grade code at speed, grounded in strong data structures and algorithms fundamentals, because compressing the time from customer problem to working solution is how FDE delivers its value. You bring genuine innovation to hard problems - your solutions are technically sound, elegant, and often non-obvious. You are the primary technical contact for 2-4 major enterprise accounts, you mentor FDEs on the team, and you are building the skills that will take you into Staff-level technical leadership.
What You'll Do

• Own complex integration and AI agent implementations end-to-end - from technical discovery through go-live and post-launch enhancement - as the primary technical contact for 2-4 enterprise accounts

• Design integration architectures with explicit attention to error handling, retry logic, observability, failure recovery, and multi-system authentication

• Design and deploy agentic AI workflows that orchestrate supply chain operations - from requirements through production, including regression testing and validation before each customer deployment

title: Last Mile Lead
description:
Do našeho skladu v Praze na Liboci hledáme nového kolegu nebo kolegyni na pozici Koordinátora kurýrní služby (Last Mile Lead).

Budeš to ty, kdo u nás v Liboci převezme dohled nad našimi kurýry a zajistí, že se tašky s nákupy dostanou k zákazníkům bleskově, kompletní a s úsměvem. Nehledáme úředníka do kanceláře, ale akčního parťáka přímo do provozu logistiky, který dokáže ukočírovat řidiče, má drajv a chce s námi každodenně posouvat kvalitu doručování na vyšší úroveň. Přidej se mezi Rohlíky!

Co tě u nás čeká?

- Dohled nad kurýry: Budeš mít pod palcem celkovou kvalitu služeb našich dopravců - pohlídáš jejich styl jízdy, včasné příjezdy, kompletnost nákupů i to, zda dodržují pravidla a reprezentují Rohlík (dresscode, kurýrní desatero).

- Denní komunikace a motivace: Budeš s kurýry v neustálém kontaktu. Předáš jim pochvalu za super výsledky, ale schytáš i řešení problémů, když něco skřípe. Tvým úkolem je držet v týmu skvělou atmosféru a nízkou fluktuaci.

- Vychytávání procesů: Budeš neustále hledat cesty, jak logistiku na Liboci zefektivnit, vyladit stávající postupy a propojovat procesy s ostatními odděleními (sklad, kvalita, bezpečnost).

- Práce se systémy: Čeká tě každodenní práce s našimi interními logistickými systémy.

- Hlídání výsledků (KPIs): Tvým hlavním cílem bude držet skvělé časy nakládek a minimalizovat zpoždění kurýrů směrem k zákazníkům.

- Práce v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden na 12h směny.

Jak si tě představujeme?

- Drive a energie: Máš v sobě dostatek drajvu pro práci v náročném logistickém prostředí a dokážeš tuhle energii přenést i na kurýry.

- Rychlá hlava a kreativita: Když standardní procesy v danou chvíli nestačí, umíš si poradit, bleskově se rozhodnout a dovést úkol do konce. Krizové situace tě nerozhodí.

- Maximální koncentrace: V logistice se toho děje hodně najednou. Ty si dokážeš udržet přehled a neztrácet focus na výsledky.

- Férový diplomat: Umíš komunikovat s různými typy lidí a každodenní mezilidské spory nebo nejasnosti řešíš sice přísně, ale vždy férově.

- Rychle se učíš: Logistika u nás letí dopředu, takže schopnost rychle nasávat nové postupy je klíčová.

Co ti za tvou skvělou práci nabídneme?

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupuj s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Možnost placeného volna - když si potřebuješ pořádně odpočnout.

- Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma - přímo na pracovišti tě čeká dobré jídlo, skvělé kafe a čerstvé ovoce každý den.

- Sbírej hvězdičky a ulov si odměnu - máme super systém vnitrofiremních pochval. S kolegy si navzájem posíláte hvězdičky, které pak snadno proměníš za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Příspěvek na ošatné - ke každé směně ti přihodíme 86 Kč navíc na oblečení.

- Multisport karta - pro tvůj sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

- Fajn firemní akce - umíme vzít za práci, ale i společně oslavit úspěchy na skvělých večírcích.

Anovia is seeking an independent contractor to join a telecommunications client's mission-critical call handling platform development team on a fixed-term through the end of Q1 2027. At iD Tech , our mission is to create life-changing tech experiences that embolden students to shape the future. We have been in business for over 21 years, and we are now a world leader in online and in-person STEM education for kids and teens.

- Risk escalation. You are the point of escalation for cross-team dependencies and you keep stakeholders aligned without routing every conversation through leadership.

You will oversee usage execution, establish product launch controls, direct partner royalty reconciliations, oversee compliance with partnership arrangements, and serve as the primary compliance lead for usage-related SOX controls and audits.

Primary Responsibilities

• Strategic Team Leadership : Lead, coach, and scale a high-performing team consisting of two functional leads covering Partnerships / Royalty, Money/Engineering Compliance, and Issue Resolution. Actively uphold our culture principles and leadership essentials in daily execution.

• Usage & Revenue Fiduciary Oversight : Serve as the primary business and compliance oversight body responsible for ensuring all usage-related, financially impacting processes are accurate, complete, SOX-compliant, and validated prior to customer billing and revenue conversion.

• Partner Agreement & Royalty Governance : Assume complete ownership of outbound/inbound royalty reporting, executions, and complex reconciliations (e.g., Azure/Microsoft, AWS, GCP, SAP). Eliminate manual operational risks, ingestion lag, timing mismatches, and contract-period attribution issues.

• Cross-Functional System Controls & "Two-in-the-Box" Execution : Partner closely with Engineering (Money Team) and Finance Data Systems (FDS) prior to product launches to validate metering, pricing models, SKU additions, and billing logic against business intent.

• Audit Ownership & Technical Accounting : Act as the primary audit lead for external audit, internal audit, and executive stakeholders regarding platform consumption calculations and monetization structures. 

• Remediation & Root Cause Analysis (RCA) : Oversee the categorization and resolution of usage issues (Types 1-3), standardize refund SLAs/credits, and drive mandatory cross-functional RCAs with Engineering to prevent systemic metering bugs.

Minimum Qualifications

• Education & Certification : Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related technical field; CPA license preferred.

• Experience : 12+ years of relevant experience, including extensive experience in revenue accounting, IT audit, and SOX control frameworks.

• Domain Expertise : Familiarity with ASC 606, specifically applied to consumption-based/usage-based revenue models, SaaS, and complex partner royalty agreements.

• Leadership & Cross-Functional Influence : Proven track record of managing managers or functional leads while directly collaborating with executive leadership across Engineering, Sales Operations, FP&A, and external auditors.

• Technical & Analytical Acumen : Ability to bridge technical systems (product metering engines, SQL/data pipelines, sub-ledgers) with accounting rules and complex contract terms.

title: Researcher Web Security, Detection
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Location- New York, NY 

About the Department

Cloudflare’s Engineering Team is home to some of the industry’s top engineers, dedicated to building and scaling innovative software that handles a huge proportion of the Internet. Our Detection department sits at the heart of that mission: we identify automated, fraudulent, and malicious activity across the Internet and through our gateway. We develop advanced detection systems and machine learning models that operate at scale, collaborating with Product and Engineering teams across the company to protect our customers and stay ahead of the constantly evolving threat landscape.

What You’ll Do

• Study our adversaries deeply - reverse-engineer bot tools, automation frameworks, and fraud kits to understand how they work and how they evolve.

• Play the cat-and-mouse game: probe our own detections like an attacker would, close the gaps, and stay a step ahead as adversaries adapt.

• Track the bot and fraud ecosystem through tooling, marketplaces, and emerging techniques. Turn that intelligence into actionable detection signals.

• Develop heuristics, signatures, and detection ideas grounded in real adversary behavior, partnering with Data Scientists and Engineers to bring them to life.

• Design mitigations that neutralize attackers without tipping our hand; preserving our detection signals rather than teaching adversaries how to evade them.

• Automate the work analysts do by hand by turning manual investigation and rule-writing into scalable, automated detection.

Must Haves

You know our adversaries. You understand bots, automation, and the tooling used to attack web applications at scale.

• Deep web expertise. You know HTTP, TLS, browser internals, fingerprinting, CAPTCHAs, and the techniques used to evade them.

• You love the hunt. You enjoy ethical hacking and reverse engineering, with an adversarial mindset that assumes every defense can be broken - and the creativity to prove it.

Who You Are

• From research to detection. You translate what you learn about attackers into concrete signals defenders can use.

• Mitigation without burning signals. You understand (or are curious to learn) how to act on attackers without burning the signals that make them detectable.

• Disciplined in code. You script comfortably (e.g., Python, JavaScript) to build proofs-of-concept and tooling - and you write it cleanly, whether it's throwaway or meant to last.

One80 Intermediaries is seeking a Senior Commercial Underwriter to join our growing team.

We are looking for a Senior Commercial Auto Underwriter to join our team. • Strong technical P&C underwriting knowledge and skills, specifically focused on Commercial Auto

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have

• C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

• Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

• Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

• Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for

• Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

Today, OMH provides superior behavioral health services to patients in Massachusetts and Colorado. Since 2016, we’ve specialized in serving both adult and adolescent patients in a supportive outpatient environment. Our practice strives to improve access to holistic and cost-effective mental health care while supporting our clinical staff in all aspects of their work. Our clinicians define this work as the perfect balance between flexibility and efficiency.

OMH offers a variety of part-time and/or full-time options to our clinicians. Packages can be customized towards every clinician’s needs. Packages can include some combination of:

· Competitive Salary

· Medical benefits

· Paid malpractice policy

· CEU reimbursement

· Paid time off (PTO) and paid holidays

· Productivity Bonuses in select areas

· Work-Life Balance

· Flexible Work Schedule

• No extra on call work, simply cover the care for your own patients!

It is common for clinicians to diversify their work today. Therefore, OMH’s flexibility and part-time options are the perfect complement to your professional and/or personal commitments. You can feel secure that OMH will offer steady, consistent income throughout your tenure.

Work from or close to home:

With locations in Colorado and Massachusetts, OMH is continuing to expand into states around the country. OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Ask to speak with our recruitment team today to identify the local office(s) in your area, as well as those offices that are being planned for launch. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHC). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower animal healthcare professionals with opportunities to earn more and achieve greater flexibility in their careers and personal lives.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the industry-leading veterinary staffing platform, connecting Veterinarians, Technicians, and Assistants with animal hospitals for relief work and hiring opportunities. Roo empowers the largest network of over 20,000 veterinary professionals to help more than 9,000 animal hospitals provide quality care to more pets.
Together, we’ve provided more than  3 million hours of healthcare, helping Veterinarians earn more than $200 million.

About the Role

As a Veterinary Account Manager, you're the one person at Roo your vets know by name: the first call when something's wrong, the advocate in the room when decisions affect them, and the reason they keep choosing Roo. You'll spot risks before they become churn and directly grow the revenue line the company watches most.

The role blends genuine relationship building with a data-informed operating rhythm. You'll work from booking data, engagement signals, and CRM insights to know each vet's story, catch changes early, and decide where your week goes. You'll also represent Roo in person through vet events, community programming, and conference presence.

Travel Requirement: Expect regular but predictable travel, quarterly vet dinners, occasional regional CE events, and one to two national conferences per year.

Your Responsibilities

• Own a dedicated book of veterinarians as their primary relationship partner inside Roo, with clear retention and revenue goals.

• Retain, engage, and grow shift volume for assigned vets through proactive relationship management.

• Diagnose engagement drops using booking and activity data, determine whether the driver is schedule, supply, price, or relationship, and run the right play.

• Act as liaison between vets and Roo teams to resolve issues, share feedback, and promote advocacy.

• Build community connection through 1:1 conversations, local vet events, and conference programming.

• Utilize CRM tools to track engagement and steer your week from the data rather than waiting for direction.

Qualifications

• 3+ years in account management, customer success, or sales.

• Proven relationship builder with strong interpersonal and communication skills.

• Proficiency in CRM and data analysis tools (HubSpot, Zendesk).

• Organized, adaptable, and self-directed: you manage multiple priorities and build your own week.

• Experience in veterinary staffing or healthcare services preferred.

title: Financial Controller & Regulatory Reporting Officer – Gibraltar
description:
ABOUT ARQ

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly. We’re still early in our journey, which means every person who joins shapes the future of our product, culture, and growth. If you’re excited by big challenges, global impact, and the chance to grow fast with a world-class team, ARQ is the place to do it.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Financial Controller & Regulatory Reporting Officer to join our Gibraltar office. This is a hands-on role with broad ownership: you will be the primary finance lead for GIB's P&L, balance sheet and regulatory reporting under DLT license to the FSC, and will additionally oversee the financial operations of ARQ UK, a cost centre within the group together with ownership of the reconciliation process of ARQ Globals financial and ledger accounts.

Reporting directly to the Group Controller, you will act as the financial backbone of two entities, ensuring integrity in reporting, compliance with local requirements, and tight control over costs. This role is ideal for a finance professional who thrives in a lean, high-ownership environment and is comfortable working across jurisdictions.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

Financial Control & Reporting:

- Own the month-end close process for GIB, ensuring timely and accurate financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards (IFRS).

- Review and maintain the P&L, balance sheet, and cash flow statements on a monthly basis.

- Maintain a robust chart of accounts and ensure proper classification of all transactions.

- Manage intercompany transactions and reconciliations between GIB and other group entities in line with our Transfer Pricing Policy.

- Support the preparation of statutory accounts and liaise with external auditors.

- Ensure compliance with local regulatory reporting requirements for the Gibraltar Company.

Cost Centre Oversight:

- Oversee the financial operations of ARQ UK as a cost centre, including monthly cost review and variance analysis.

- Ensure all ARQ UK costs are correctly allocated, accrued, and reported in line with group policies.

- Monitor budgets versus actuals for ARQ UK and escalate material variances to the Group Financial Controller.

- Coordinate with local stakeholders in the UK to gather financial data and validate reporting accuracy.

Budgeting & Forecasting:

- Contribute to the annual budgeting process for GIB and ARQ UK, working closely with the Group Financial Controller.

- Prepare rolling forecasts and provide commentary on financial performance drivers.

- Develop financial models to support business decisions and scenario planning.

Controls & Compliance:

- Design, implement, and maintain robust internal controls for both GIB and ARQ UK.

- Ensure adherence to group accounting policies and flag any deviations or exceptions.

- Serve as the primary point of contact with the outsourced accounting provider, coordinating and reviewing the preparation and delivery of financial statements and periodic financial reports for GIB and ARQ UK.

- Ensure the accurate calculation, provisioning, and timely payment of all applicable taxes for both entities, working in close collaboration with external tax advisors.

- Monitor and ensure full compliance with the regulatory requirements of Gibraltar and the United Kingdom, keeping abreast of changes in local legislation and promptly escalating any compliance risks to the Group Controller.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

- Professional accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent).

- 5+ years of relevant experience in financial control, accounting, or audit roles.

- Proven track record of owning month-end close and preparing statutory-quality financial statements.

- Experience working in or with regulated financial services entities.

- Strong knowledge of IFRS or UK GAAP.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

Payments Product Sales is a team of deep functional and technical specialists who lead and advise on opportunities for some of the most strategically important products in Stripe’s portfolio. We work alongside Stripe’s Core Sales and Customer Success teams to help users adopt products that improve payment experiences, increase conversion, support international growth, and create new sources of revenue.

We are hiring an Account Executive, Product - Local Payment Methods to grow adoption of Stripe’s local payment methods across AMER. This role will work across Stripe’s global LPM portfolio while developing particular expertise in the payment preferences, market dynamics, and user opportunities most relevant to North America and Latin America.
